# OutdoorSteamSauna.com

> Independent U.S. climate, energy-cost and planning data for outdoor traditional saunas.

Dataset version: 2.0
Methodology version: 2.0
Dataset updated: 2026-09-14
NOAA recent observations through: 2026-09-12
EIA electricity period: 2026-06

## Canonical resources
- Climate Index: https://outdoorsteamsauna.com/climate-index/
- Methodology: https://outdoorsteamsauna.com/methodology/
- Dataset and citation guide: https://outdoorsteamsauna.com/data-download/
- Data dictionary: https://outdoorsteamsauna.com/data-dictionary/
- 2026 Climate Report: https://outdoorsteamsauna.com/research/2026-outdoor-sauna-climate-report/
- State electricity-cost report: https://outdoorsteamsauna.com/research/sauna-electricity-cost-by-state/
- Editorial standards: https://outdoorsteamsauna.com/editorial-standards/
- Corrections: https://outdoorsteamsauna.com/corrections/
- Changelog: https://outdoorsteamsauna.com/changelog/

## Machine-readable files
- JSON: https://outdoorsteamsauna.com/data/cities.json
- City CSV: https://outdoorsteamsauna.com/data/outdoor-sauna-index.csv
- State cost CSV: https://outdoorsteamsauna.com/data/outdoor-sauna-state-costs.csv

## Interpretation rules
- Climate Stress Score excludes electricity price.
- Operating Cost Index uses state residential electricity prices.
- Planning Index is an optional 80% climate / 20% cost composite.
- null snowfall means unavailable, never zero.
- City electricity values are state averages, not local utility quotes.
- Calculations are planning comparisons, not engineering or code approval.
